SELECT id, area_code, area_name, qxdm, qxmc, type, lx, bt, xq, htbh, dkbh, htid, dkid, num, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM jgpt_yj
AND (area_code = #{areaCode} OR qxdm LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 6), '%'))
AND type = #{type}
AND gmt_create >= #{startTime}::timestamp
AND gmt_create <= #{endTime}::timestamp
AND (bt LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR xq LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR htbh LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dkbh LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY gmt_create DESC

SELECT type AS warning_type, COUNT(1) AS total_count, CASE WHEN type = '01' THEN '合同到期预警' WHEN type = '02' THEN '地块异常预警' WHEN type = '03' THEN '收缴费用异常预警' WHEN type = '04' THEN '人员信息异常预警' WHEN type = '05' THEN '耕地非粮化预警' ELSE '其他异常预警' END AS type_name FROM jgpt_yj
AND (area_code = #{areaCode} OR qxdm LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 6), '%'))
GROUP BY type ORDER BY total_count DESC

SELECT COALESCE(area_code, qxdm) AS district_code, MAX(COALESCE(area_name, qxmc, '未知区县')) AS district_name, COUNT(1) AS warning_count, SUM(CASE WHEN type = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS htdq_count, SUM(CASE WHEN type = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dkyc_count, SUM(CASE WHEN type = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sjfy_count, SUM(CASE WHEN type = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ryxx_count, SUM(CASE WHEN type = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fglh_count FROM jgpt_yj
AND (area_code = #{areaCode} OR qxdm LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 6), '%'))
GROUP BY COALESCE(area_code, qxdm) ORDER BY warning_count DESC
